notes.title: SPARROW DEMO
notes.notes:
We are pleased to announce that the DEMO for SPARROW is now available! Check it out and then leave us some feedback! Any and all input will help us improve the final game! 

Head on over to the store page to get the demo or leave us a review: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3210580/SPARROW_DEMO/

If you encounter any bugs, suffer any performance issues, or have any other comments please feel free to reach out to us at contact@phantomlakegames.com
